rationale: The agent did look up the user and order, which aligns with authentication and scope, but it violated key policy requirements. It executed order-changing writes (two separate exchange_delivered_order_items calls) without first confirming with the user. It also used the same item_id twice in each call and then performed two separate exchanges with different new_item_ids, implying duplicate/overlapping actions beyond the user’s two requested exchanges and likely affecting four items instead of two. There’s no evidence the replacements were correctly mapped to the requested attributes, nor any final confirmation or summary to the user. These constitute policy violations and incorrect actions, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
